sloka: स्व पुरम् प्रविवेशत् वीरः पिता तस्य तुतोष ह ।गते च भरते रामो लक्ष्मणः च महाबलः ॥१-७७-२०॥
transliteration: sva puram praviveśat vīraḥ pitā tasya tutoṣa ha ।gate ca bharate rāmo lakṣmaṇaḥ ca mahābalaḥ ॥1-77-20॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Dasaratha, Bharata, son of Kaikeyi paid obeisance to his father and Rama, embraced Lakshmana and prepared for the journey with Satrughna.
translations.hindi: शफ बालुकारडे, इस प्रकार राजा जनक से बिदा हो महाराज दशरथ दोनों सुनियों को आगे कर, तुरन्त चल दिए
